hooks.logic:
If the enemy has the NULL_PHYSICAL status, then
  Let resultObjectsInFrame be the results "on_damaged_physical" this frame.
  If the length of resultObjectsInFrame is more than 0, then
    If not run helper6 on resultObjectsInFrame, then the enemy → unset-status-ailments with (the NULL_PHYSICAL status).
If the enemy has the NULL_MAGIC status, then
  Let resultObjectsInFrame2 be the results "on_damaged_masic" this frame.
  If the length of resultObjectsInFrame2 is more than 0, then
    If not run helper6 on resultObjectsInFrame2, then the enemy → unset-status-ailments with (the NULL_MAGIC status).
If condition flag "on_damaged_for_counter" is up this frame, then
  Let v be run helper9.
  If v is not 0, then the enemy gains v.
If condition flag "targeting" is up this frame, then run helper7.
If the register's 'targetType' is 0, then
  If the form for the enemy under the phases list is not "2", then choose state 13 next and stop.
If the register's 'abilityTagForTarget' is not "nothing", then
  Reset the enemy.
  If run helper4, then
    If the register's 'targetType' is 1, then run helper11.
    Otherwise, run helper12.
    Run helper8.
  Stop.
If the enemy is ready to act, then
  If the register's 'targetType' is 0, then the enemy picks and uses a smart-weighted move and stop.
  Reset the enemy.
  Set the register's 'abilityTagForTarget' to a random pick from ["evil_rocket_punch", "evil_mustard_bomb"].
